newsitem.title: UK: MTV to launch two new music TV channels in Britain.
newsitem.headline: MTV to launch two new music TV channels in Britain.

text.p: MTV Networks Europe said it will launch two new music television channels in Britain, MTV in the UK and M2: Music Television.

MTV in the UK will be a music and youth entertainment channel targeted at 16- to 34-year-olds and will replace MTV Europe's existing Northern service currently shown in the UK. It will be broadcast via the British Sky Broadcasting basic package and on cable networks.
The M2: Music Television channel will feature a "freeform" music format broadcast live to Britain from the U.S.
MTV is owned by U.S. cable television and entertainment group Viacom Inc.. -- London Advertising Newsdesk +44 171 542 2815
